A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NCI research and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. The earlier appendices can be matched to the later supplementary sections despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v6 reports original NCI detection, latency, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendices B and D. These are distinct from the explicitly reproduced Neural Collapse figures.

after.justification: v7 retains those original results and adds an early-training detection result, a T2FNorm compatibility experiment, and additional baseline comparisons.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same centered-feature pScore, additive feature-norm filtering, and thresholding procedure in Section 3.3. The T2FNorm experiment evaluates the unchanged post-hoc detector under another training configuration.

E1.justification: The CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, and associated OOD datasets are retained. The added experiments reuse existing coverage; MCM is applied to the existing vision models, without introducing a vision-language task.

E2.justification: Appendix 11 adds evaluated GEN and SHE comparisons in the CIFAR-10/ImageNet settings and MCM comparisons on ViT and Swin. Existing comparator sets are retained. SHE's source was already cited in v6, but these comparisons were absent.

E3.justification: New evaluations include CE versus T2FNorm training for ResNet-18, separate near/far OOD averages, an epoch-50 checkpoint comparison, and MCM temperature sweeping over 0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10. Existing benchmark settings and NCI hyperparameter-selection procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v7 adds a training-regularization compatibility analysis in Appendix 10/Table 8 and quantitative early-training detection evidence. The training-stage similarity curves are revised, while the existing proximity-metric, filtering-norm, filtering-strength, and KNN-filtering analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version introduces repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The classwise variation statistics in the reproduced Neural Collapse figures are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark tables retain their values. v7 adds epoch-50 AUROC of 94.44 for NCI versus 91.27 for MSP, T2FNorm near/far AUROC of 92.72/97.56, and GEN/SHE/MCM results. The matched training plot changes its approximate final ID/OOD similarities from 0.85/0.57 to 0.89/0.70. Appendix 11 reports NCI Swin AUROC as 80.94, although Table 2 retains 80.97.

T1.justification: The Neural Collapse definitions, Theorem 3.1, its proof, and the mathematical scoring formulations are retained. Changes to feature-index notation and surrounding explanations do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The central claims about weight-aligned ID clusters, feature norms, efficient detection, and reduced generalization discrepancies without complete collapse remain. v7 makes the already-used centering operation explicit in the opening claims and adds supporting evidence.

C2.justification: Appendix 10 and Section 5 newly interpret the T2FNorm experiment as evidence that NCI can benefit from training-time OOD regularization. Existing interpretations concerning clustering, ETF geometry, filtering, and weak clustering are retained.

D1.justification: v7 adds an NCI code-availability statement and repository link in the abstract. Existing implementation recipes and checkpoint references remain, and the new MCM comparison documents its temperature grid.

R1.justification: v7 adds references and discussion for GEN, MCM, and T2FNorm, extending comparison and compatibility positioning. The principal relationship to prior clustering-based and Neural Collapse methods remains unchanged; SHE's underlying paper was already cited.

P1.justification: The abstract and substantial portions of the introduction are rewritten around centered features, theoretical convergence, and practical hypotheses. Repeated convergence/performance remarks are consolidated, Section 3.2 is shortened and reorganized, and the appendices become numbered supplementary sections with additional sections and acknowledgments.

P2.justification: The document switches from predominantly single-column to two-column layout, extensively relocating and resizing displays. The training plot is redrawn and becomes Figure 1, the framework becomes Figure 2, near/far table headers are added, Table 5 is transposed, and a new Table 8 precedes the retained DenseNet table.

improvement.justification: v7 adds useful evidence about training-regularization compatibility and additional comparators, clarifies centering, and supplies code-access information while preserving the original method and results. These modest gains outweigh the limited documentation of new experiments and the small Swin AUROC inconsistency between Appendix 11 and Table 2.
